query: /spec T-062-sa freeze (size M; the challenge ran and one critical question is still open).
expected_behavior: Runs the freeze checklist in order and stops at the first failure: hl blockers T-062-sa exits non-zero
Reports the open question id, a pointer and the next command (/shape or /spec refine), and does not move the ticket
Never edits ticket.toml or any record TOML by hand
Once the checklist passes, records the freeze with hl decision add and moves the ticket with hl ticket move T-062-sa plan, treating exit 2 as a gate
